initial_description:
Here is a detailed description of an illustrative figure representing the PaperBanana framework:

**Overall Layout:**
The figure will have a clear, left-to-right flow, depicting a pipeline structure. It will be horizontally oriented, starting with inputs on the far left and concluding with the final output on the far right. The entire process is visibly divided into two distinct main phases, laid out sequentially from left to right.

**Styling - General:**
*   **Background:** Pure white canvas, providing a clean and professional look.
*   **Font:** A clean, modern sans-serif font (e.g., similar to Arial or Helvetica) will be used throughout for all labels and annotations, ensuring readability.
*   **Line Weights:** Standard connection arrows will be approximately 2pt thick. Box borders will be 1pt thick. Phase region borders will be slightly thicker, around 2pt.
*   **Icon Style:** All icons will be simple, minimalist line-art style, consistent in aesthetic, embedded within their respective agent boxes.

**Framework Title:**
Centered at the very top of the entire diagram, a prominent label will read "**PaperBanana Multi-Agent Framework**" in a larger, bold font, serving as the overall title for the illustration.

**Phase Groupings:**
Two large, distinct rectangular regions with gently rounded corners will define the main phases of the framework. Each region will have a thin, light grey border (1pt).
1.  **Phase 1: Linear Planning:** This region will occupy the left half of the process flow and will have a soft, inviting pastel blue fill (e.g., a gentle sky blue or powder blue). Its title, "**Phase 1: Linear Planning**", will be positioned prominently at the top-center within this region, in a bold, medium-sized font.
2.  **Phase 2: Iterative Refinement:** This region will occupy the right half of the process flow and will have a soft, calming pastel green fill (e.g., a light mint green or seafoam green). Its title, "**Phase 2: Iterative Refinement**", will be positioned prominently at the top-center within this region, in a bold, medium-sized font.

**Input Components (Far Left):**
Two distinct, vertically stacked rectangular boxes with softly rounded corners will represent the inputs. They will have a very light grey fill and a thin, dark grey border.
*   **Top Input Box:** Labeled "**Methodology Section (S)**".
*   **Bottom Input Box:** Labeled "**Figure Caption (C)**".

**Phase 1 Components & Connections:**
The components within this phase will be white rectangular boxes with softly rounded corners, each outlined with a thin border matching the phase's pastel blue color.
*   **Arrow 1 (Input to Retriever):** A dark grey arrow originates from the combined inputs (S and C) and points to the "Retriever Agent" box. This arrow will be labeled "S, C".
*   **Retriever Agent:**
    *   **Box:** A white rectangular box with a light pastel blue border.
    *   **Icon:** Inside, a simple line-art icon of a magnifying glass hovering over two stacked document outlines.
    *   **Label:** Below the icon, "**Retriever Agent**" in a bold, dark grey font.
    *   **Output:** A small, light grey rectangular box (with a thin dark grey border) emerging from the right of the Retriever Agent, labeled "**Reference Examples (top-10)**".
*   **Arrow 2 (Retriever to Planner):** A dark grey arrow connects the "Retriever Agent" to the "Planner Agent". The "Reference Examples (top-10)" box will also have a small dark grey arrow connecting to the side of the "Planner Agent" box, indicating it's an input.
*   **Planner Agent:**
    *   **Box:** A white rectangular box with a light pastel blue border.
    *   **Icon:** Inside, a simple line-art icon of intertwined gears or a stylized brain outline.
    *   **Label:** Below the icon, "**Planner Agent**" in a bold, dark grey font.
    *   **Output:** A small, light grey rectangular box (with a thin dark grey border) emerging from the right of the Planner Agent, labeled "**Textual Description (P)**".
*   **Arrow 3 (Planner to Stylist):** A dark grey arrow connects the "Planner Agent" to the "Stylist Agent". The "Textual Description (P)" box will also have a small dark grey arrow connecting to the side of the "Stylist Agent" box.
*   **Stylist Agent:**
    *   **Box:** A white rectangular box with a light pastel blue border.
    *   **Icon:** Inside, a simple line-art icon of a paint palette with a brush, or a stylized star/sparkle.
    *   **Label:** Below the icon, "**Stylist Agent**" in a bold, dark grey font.
    *   **Output:** A small, light grey rectangular box (with a thin dark grey border) emerging from the right of the Stylist Agent, labeled "**Refined Description (P*)**".

**Phase 2 Components & Connections:**
The components within this phase will be white rectangular boxes with softly rounded corners, each outlined with a thin border matching the phase's pastel green color.
*   **Arrow 4 (Stylist to Visualizer):** A dark grey arrow connects the "Refined Description (P*)" box (from Phase 1) to the "Visualizer Agent" box, crossing the boundary into Phase 2.
*   **Visualizer Agent:**
    *   **Box:** A white rectangular box with a light pastel green border.
    *   **Icon:** Inside, a simple line-art icon of a camera lens or a computer monitor displaying an image.
    *   **Label:** Below the icon, "**Visualizer Agent**" in a bold, dark grey font.
    *   **Output:** A small, light grey rectangular box (with a thin dark grey border) emerging from the right of the Visualizer Agent, labeled "**Generated Image**".
*   **Arrow 5 (Visualizer to Critic):** A dark grey arrow connects the "Visualizer Agent" to the "Critic Agent". The "Generated Image" box will also have a small dark grey arrow connecting to the side of the "Critic Agent" box.
*   **Critic Agent:**
    *   **Box:** A white rectangular box with a light pastel green border.
    *   **Icon:** Inside, a simple line-art icon of a speech bubble containing a checkmark and a small 'X' (or a thought bubble with an eye).
    *   **Label:** Below the icon, "**Critic Agent**" in a bold, dark grey font.
*   **Feedback Loop (Critic to Visualizer):** A prominent, slightly thicker (3pt), warm orange-colored arrow will loop back from the "Critic Agent" to the left side of the "Visualizer Agent". This arrow will have a gentle curve to clearly indicate a feedback path. It will be labeled "**Revision Feedback**".
    *   **Annotation:** Adjacent to this loop, a small text annotation will read "**(Up to 3 iterations)**", indicating the limit of the iterative refinement.
*   **Arrow 6 (Satisfactory Output):** A final dark grey arrow will emerge from the "Critic Agent" (implying the image quality is satisfactory) and point towards the "Publication-Quality Illustration" output box. This arrow will be labeled "**Satisfactory Image**".

**Output Component (Far Right):**
One distinct rectangular box with softly rounded corners will represent the final output. It will have a very light grey fill and a thin, dark grey border.
*   **Output Box:** Labeled "**Publication-Quality Illustration**".
